Video Production

This is for you if you want a beautiful, moving video right at the top of your website homepage, if you are getting ready to open the doors to a brand-new project, or if you want a mini-documentary that tells the story behind why you do what you do.

We take care of everything, from researching your audience and mapping out your story arc, doing all the on-location filming, and handling the editing and music licensing.

You get a main 2–3 minute signature brand video, plus 2 shorter clips ready to drop straight into your social media.

Investment starts at €1000

Social Media Video Packages

This is a year-long creative partnership for busy founders who are sick of the endless social media treadmill, but still want to show up online regularly while saving time for the work they love.

We come and spend 3 to 4 days fully immersing ourselves in your world, quietly capturing a library of behind-the-scenes moments while you just go about your normal routine.

You get 2 high-quality, beautifully crafted reels delivered straight to your inbox every single month for a year.

Investment starts at €1200

Custom Projects

This is for you if you have a unique video project in mind that doesn't fit into a tidy box.

We listen to your vision, and build a tailored plan, handling everything from the initial story-mapping to the final cinematic edits.

Deliverables are fully customised to fit exactly what your story needs.

Investment is custom-quoted based on your project.

Our Stress Free Process

1. From Watching to Doing

We help turn your customers’ challenges into action through audience research, story planning, filming, and editing.

2. Relaxed and Organised

We handle logistics, timelines, revisions, and licensing so the process feels easy and relaxed.

3. Storytelling

We create emotional, memorable stories that feel real and human, not generic.

4. Every Detail Matters

Colours, sound, framing, lighting, and pacing are carefully considered to build a visual world around your story.
